scope: English guidance for Verizon consumer postpaid mobile accounts: SIM Protection and My Verizon account access. Prepaid, business accounts, port-outs, identity disputes and unsupported recovery circumstances are handed to official support.

questions.prompt: Is this a Verizon consumer postpaid mobile account?

choices.label: No, a prepaid, business, or different account

questions.prompt: What are you trying to do?

choices.label: Change a SIM or device while SIM Protection may be on
Move my number to another carrier

questions.prompt: Can you sign in to My Verizon now?
questions.help: Do not share your credentials here. Complete sign-in only on Verizon’s official site.

questions.prompt: Does that sign-in have Account Owner or Account Manager access?

choices.label: No, Account Member or another role

outcomes.title: Use the guidance for your account type
outcomes.nextStep: This guide covers consumer postpaid accounts. Choose the appropriate account guidance through Verizon’s official support pages.
unresolved: The requirements for your account type are not established by this flow.

outcomes.title: Confirm your account type first
outcomes.nextStep: Use Verizon’s account help to confirm which service and account type you have before following a SIM Protection procedure.

outcomes.title: Number transfer needs a separate procedure
outcomes.nextStep: SIM Protection and Number Lock address different changes. Use Verizon’s official Number Lock and transfer guidance for a port-out.
unresolved: This flow does not establish your port-out prerequisites.

outcomes.title: Check the official options
outcomes.nextStep: Read Verizon’s SIM Protection and account-access pages to identify the task that fits your situation.

outcomes.title: Check account access on Verizon’s site
outcomes.nextStep: Try the official My Verizon sign-in route. If a verification step is unavailable, use Verizon’s account-access help.
unresolved: This guide cannot confirm your sign-in or verification options.

outcomes.title: Check the account role
outcomes.nextStep: Confirm access with the Account Owner or an authorized Account Manager. Account Member access is limited.
unresolved: No role change or recovery outcome is promised.

outcomes.title: Turn on protection through My Verizon
outcomes.nextStep: Open Account → Account settings → Security settings. Edit SIM Protection for the intended line, turn it on, save, and complete any verification Verizon requests.
prerequisites: An Account Owner or Manager sign-in.
Access to any verification required by Verizon.

outcomes.title: Review the protection change before proceeding
outcomes.nextStep: For an intended SIM or device change, edit SIM Protection in My Verizon’s Security settings. Disabling it does not permit an immediate transaction: Verizon describes a 15-minute block and possible additional delay.
prerequisites: An authorized Owner or Manager sign-in.
A deliberate, legitimate SIM or device change.
unresolved: Follow Verizon’s current confirmation and timing instructions.

outcomes.title: Continue with Verizon’s device procedure
outcomes.nextStep: Use Verizon’s official support for the intended SIM or device change. This flow does not complete or validate activation.
unresolved: Activation prerequisites and timing remain with Verizon.

outcomes.title: Check the affected line’s setting
outcomes.nextStep: Review SIM Protection for the line in My Verizon’s Security settings before deciding whether any change is needed.

outcomes.title: Use Verizon’s password recovery
outcomes.nextStep: Use the password-recovery link in Verizon’s account-access FAQ and follow its prompts. The same FAQ addresses lockout after repeated failed sign-in attempts.
unresolved: Required verification and recovery success are not established here.

outcomes.title: Ask Verizon about the unavailable verification
outcomes.nextStep: Use Verizon’s official account-access support. Explain which verification option you cannot use; do not provide credentials or codes to this website.
unresolved: No bypass, store override, or guaranteed recovery route has been verified.
